Aricia Residences is developed by Aricia Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary. Construction target: Q3 2029.

FAQ · 常见问题

Common Questions

买家常问问题解答

Aricia Residences is Freehold — one of the rare freehold new launches in the Sungai Besi / Chan Sow Lin corridor. Land is owned in perpetuity by the owner, providing long-term asset preservation and typically easier bank financing.

Aricia是永久地契，在新街场/陈秀连走廊属于稀有资源，产权永久属于业主。

The booking fee is only RM500 — and it is fully refundable upon cancellation before SPA signing. There is zero risk to register your interest and secure a unit while you do your due diligence.

订金仅RM500，取消可全额退款，零风险。

Yes — SPA legal fee & disbursement, as well as loan legal fee, disbursement & stamp duty are all fully waived for buyers. These savings can amount to tens of thousands of ringgit depending on your purchase price. Contact me for a full breakdown of your total costs.

SPA及贷款法律费用全免，节省可观。联系我获取完整费用估算。

Via MRT Putrajaya Line from Chan Sow Lin Station: 1 stop to TRX (The Exchange), 2 stops to Conlay, 3 stops to Persiaran KLCC. A complimentary shuttle bus service is also provided to the MRT station.

搭MRT Putrajaya线，从陈秀连站出发，一站到达TRX金融中心。

All units come with: Inverter air-conditioners (all bedrooms + living), SIGNATURE brand kitchen cabinet (with hood & hob), digital smart door lock, Smart Home System, shoe cabinet space, washing machine placement area, and fiber wall socket. Type A/B/C also have a Fully Furnished Package option.

标配：变频冷气、SIGNATURE厨柜、数码智能门锁、智能家居系统。A/B/C型另有全配置选项。

Yes. The Duplex units Type D1 (from RM1.06M) and Type D2 (from RM1.07M) are priced above RM1 million and are eligible for foreign purchase, subject to KL Land Office (PTG) approval. Contact me for details on foreign purchaser requirements.

可以。复式D1及D2售价超过RM100万，符合外国人购房资格，须获PTG批准。

Estimated Vacant Possession (VP) is Q3 2029, approximately 56 months from SPA signing. Construction is already in progress (as at March 2026). Built by Chin Hin Group's QLASSIC-certified construction arm.

预计2029年第三季度（VP），SPA签署后约56个月。施工已在进行中（截至2026年3月）。

Estimated maintenance fee is approximately RM0.38 per sq ft per month (inclusive of sinking fund), based on the allocated share unit. Subject to actual JMB/MC rates upon VP.

预计维护费约每平方尺RM0.38/月（含沉没基金），以实际股份单位计算。
